# c0depad 1.3.14

- Keep c0depad running with its scratch buffer when closing the window on macOS; reopen from the Dock or summon shortcut.
- Route Quit and Command-Q through an explicit native exit command; remove the unresolvable frontend plugin import.
- Limit scroll-past-end padding to five rendered lines, with a cap for short windows.

This Gumroad-first build is for manual confirmation of Command-W, reopen, and Command-Q behavior. Native keypress behavior has not been automated-verified.
